fields.mechanism: Fuzzy semantic optimal control with reinforcement learning and proximal policy optimization to resolve ambiguity and maximize output quality under uncertainty.
fields.intervention: Apply a fuzzy semantic optimal control layer to the EV’s real-time power and torque management, using reinforcement learning with proximal policy optimization to continuously tune acceleration and energy-recovery parameters based on driving context and semantic similarity of driving patterns.
fields.expected_effect: Improved acceleration response and reduced energy consumption per kilometer by optimizing control decisions under uncertain driving conditions, potentially exceeding Tesla Model Y acceleration and BYD Seal efficiency.
fields.falsification_test: Benchmark the EV against Tesla Model Y (0–100 km/h) and BYD Seal (Wh/km) on a standardized drive cycle; if acceleration is not faster and energy per km is not lower after 100 trials, the mechanism is falsified.
fields.mechanism_source_span: maximizing the translation output using optimal control techniques with the incorporation of Reinforcement Learning and Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) techniques

fields.mechanism: Fuzzy semantic optimal control with reinforcement learning and proximal policy optimization to resolve ambiguity and improve output quality under uncertainty.
fields.intervention: Apply a fuzzy semantic optimal control layer to the EV’s real-time power and energy management controller, using reinforcement learning with PPO to continuously optimize acceleration torque and regenerative braking decisions under uncertain driving conditions.
